Sitar Maestro Niladri Kumaar releases his all New Single 'SHIVAYA'
One of the most powerful chants "Om Nama Shivaya" travels into another imagined dimension of space and time, through the sounds of Sitar, beats and whats unique is his Father and Guru Pandit Kartick Kumar's voice which was recorded unaware, during a conversation about Music in Bengali. The 3 Principles - Sincerity, Devotion, Honesty - Tulsikauns, The Raag that Pandit Kartick Kumar created and the chants of Om Nama Shivaya come together in this all new release - SHIVAYA.
